name: SharpSports
description: Self-service sportsbook account linking, bet history/analytics, market selections and hosted betPlace contexts. Free sandbox, no credit card; real account syncing requires a paid BetSync subscription (advertised from $500/month), and betPlace is a separate paid product (advertised $1,750/month). Use public/private keys from the same environment; sandbox and live share this API host and use different keys. Account linking for SDK-required books needs SharpSports SDK integration. betPlace opens a prefilled sportsbook slip for user completion, not unattended betting execution. Docs: https://docs.sharpsports.io . Signup: https://app.sharpsports.io

tools.description: Create a BetSync linking context with your unique internalId; use the returned cid in the provider linking UI and SDK. This HTTP tool does not embed or implement the required SharpSports SDK.

tools.name: create_bet_place_context
tools.description: Create a betPlace context for a selection or synced bet slip. Use the returned cid in https://ui.sharpsports.io/place/<cid>. The user reviews and places the final bet in the sportsbook; this does not execute a wager. Requires betPlace access. Verify marketSelection betPlaceAvailability for the chosen book.

internalId.description: the internalId of the bettor relevant to the session

betSlip.description: the id of the betSlip you want to create a tail link for

marketSelection.description: the id of the marketSelection to create a betPlace link for.  Use a comma separated list of marketSelection Ids to create a parlay link

bookAbbr.description: the abbr of the book you are creating the betPlace link for

line.description: optional param to specify the line of the betslip the user wants to place

tools.name: list_market_selections
tools.description: 📜 marketSelection list Full provider response is preserved. Uses the private API key from the selected sandbox/live environment.

sdioMarketId.description: the Sportsdata.io Market ID associated with this MarketSelection

sdioEventId.description: the Sportsdata.io Event ID associated with this MarketSelection

sportradarEventId.description: the Sportradar Event ID associated with this MarketSelection

sportradarMarketId.description: the Sportradar Market ID associated with this MarketSelection

oddsjamEventId.description: the OddsJam Event ID associated with this MarketSelection

oddsjamMarketId.description: the OddsJam Market ID associated with this MarketSelection

eventId.description: the SharpSports Event ID associated with this MarketSelection

position.description: the position of the marketSelection.  This will take the positionID if it is a player or a team

type.description: filter the marketSelection list by type. Valid options are `straight` and `prop`.

segment.description: the SharpSports Segment ID or name associated with this MarketSelection

team.description: the SharpSports Team ID or name associated with this MarketSelection (only for props)

player.description: the SharpSports Player ID or name associated with this MarketSelection (only for props)

metric.description: the SharpSports Metric ID or name associated with this MarketSelection (only for props)

lineAvailability.description: serialize a list of currently available lines by book

line.description: filter the marketSelection list by a specific line. When combined with the `metadata` param, the returned metadata is recomputed for the line passed as the query param rather than the main line.

minOdds.description: Minimum American odds. For each MarketSelection we pick the line whose best available odds fall within the range and skip selections where no line qualifies. When combined with the `metadata` param, metadata and `bestPrice` are recomputed at that chosen line rather than the main line. DFS books are excluded. Must be an integer.

maxOdds.description: Maximum American odds. Behaves the same as `minOdds` and may be used on its own or together with it. If both are supplied, `minOdds` must be less than or equal to `maxOdds`.

limit.description: The max number of MarketSelection objects to be returned, ordered by timeCreated

historic.description: When true, include past/no-longer-available market selections (by default only currently-available selections are returned). Because past events cannot be bet on, historic responses omit the betPlaceAvailability and betPlaceUrls keys.

marketOffer.description: the id of the marketOffer associated with the marketSelections

teamAggStats.description: add aggregate statistics to metadata for teams. requires the metadata param

filteredTeamAggStats.description: add filtered aggregate team statistics to metadata based on market relevance

playerAggStats.description: add aggregate statistics to metadata for player props. requires the metadata param

filteredPlayerAggStats.description: add filtered player aggregate statistics to metadata based on market relevance
